findings.poc: Trigger high-concurrency secret operations against GCP Secret Manager. The missing-unlock-in-return-path causes mutex to never release, leading to goroutine exhaustion and eventual deadlock when concurrent requests exhaust the goroutine pool. Exploit: Run multiple concurrent ExternalSecret reconciliation loops targeting GCP provider.
findings.fix: Replace defer with explicit unlock before all return statements: unlock(m.secretVersionCacheMutex) at every return point, or refactor to use RWMutex with read locks and ensure all goroutine paths release locks.
findings.impact: CRITICAL: Deadlock and goroutine exhaustion causing denial of service via concurrent secret fetch operations

findings.fix: Same fix as above - ensure explicit unlock on all code paths.

findings.poc: Configure MITM proxy to advertise TLS 1.0/1.1 support. Target ExternalSecret instances using senhasegura provider. Attacker intercepts traffic, downgrades TLS connection, performs decryption. Attack requires positioning between ESO operator and senhasegura DSM API endpoint.
findings.fix: Set tls.Config{MinVersion: tls.VersionTLS12} to enforce TLS 1.2 minimum. Disable TLS 1.0/1.1 support explicitly.
findings.impact: HIGH: TLS downgrade attack allowing man-in-the-middle decryption of sensitive secret transit

findings.poc: Same TLS downgrade attack vector against DSM API endpoint.
findings.fix: Set tls.Config{MinVersion: tls.VersionTLS12} and explicitly disable older versions.
findings.impact: HIGH: TLS downgrade allowing MITM decryption of secrets
